narr: Strong thunderstorms produced torrential rainfall across the Cuyama Valley, producing flash flooding and debris flows across Highway 166.
ev: Strong thunderstorms generated torrential rainfall across the Cuyama Valley, producing flash flooding across Highway 166 near Wasioja Road. Twenty three vehicles were stuck in the flood waters and debris on Highway 166.
lsr: Hwy 166 flooded, about 10 miles west of Cuyama near Wasioja Road.
Road closure of hwy 166 due to flooding & mud.
